title: opentsx.vector.v1
description: Draft. One measuring point of a vector Smart Topic: the values of several DAG nodes for one key in one tick of a common clock. Written by the operator align.vector, see docs/datamodel-2026/11-SMART-TOPIC-PROZESSOR-DEVOPS.md, section 5a.

vector.description: Name of the vector, the bucket name of the node that wrote it.

key.description: What the vector belongs to. key: series gives the tags of the series plus its id under `series`; key: <tag> gives that tag only; key: all gives an empty object.

ts.description: End of the tick, the time from which the vector is complete. UTC, ISO-8601. A number of seconds only for data without absolute time (workbench preview).

window.description: The tick as half-open interval [from, to). Ticks are multiples of the clock since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z.

clock.description: Length of a tick as ISO-8601 duration in seconds.

components.description: Names of the components, in the order of the inputs of the node. The order is fixed for a version of the DAG.

values.description: One value per component, same order and length as `components`. null: the component has no value in this tick.

provenance.description: Set by a runtime: DAG name, version and specification hash. The workbench preview leaves it out.
